lineage.strategy: Add same-day independent reporting on manufacturing capacity and customer-mix evolution rather than repeat quarterly filings.

observations.fact: Planet Labs opened a Berlin manufacturing facility reported to have capacity for up to 60 high-resolution Pelican satellites annually, its first production site outside California and a material expansion of production footprint.
The report says defense now represents about 60% of Planet's business, highlighting a substantial shift toward government/security demand in Europe.

risks.risk: A heavier defense mix increases exposure to procurement cycles, sovereign budgets and geopolitical demand concentration; installed factory capacity is not the same as utilized output or contracted revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Berlin utilization ramp, unit economics, incremental capex and contracted production volume are not established by this report.

recommendation: Use as fresh capacity/customer-mix evidence; preserve utilization and economics as unknown until issuer-level data corroborate them.
